titulo.estudio: Lire une étiquette sanitaire : Lire l'ensemble
titulo.alumno: Reading a health label: Integrated reading

intro: Look for the instruction, the warning and the conditions of use on an information label. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Key words: reading a health label

texto: Look for the instruction, the warning and the conditions of use on an information label. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: impersonal constructions and object pronouns say what must be done or avoided. In this passage, «étiquette» means «label».

frases.estudio: L'étiquette précise que ce produit peut provoquer une légère somnolence chez certaines personnes.
frases.alumno: The label states that this product may cause slight drowsiness in some people.

frases.estudio: Il est conseillé de le prendre le soir, sauf indication différente d'un professionnel.
frases.alumno: It is advisable to take it in the evening, unless a professional advises otherwise.

frases.estudio: Conservez le flacon à température ambiante et hors de portée des enfants.
frases.alumno: Keep the bottle at room temperature and out of reach of children.

frases.estudio: Si un effet inattendu apparaît, arrêtez l'utilisation et demandez conseil à un pharmacien.
frases.alumno: If an unexpected effect appears, stop using it and consult a pharmacist.
